name: Reiko Amamiya
source:
The Auditor

A serious auditor dispatched by the ship’s sponsor.
She served as Leil’s second-in-command during her military service, and after Leil left the military, she was expected to be promoted but was not.
Because of this, she became obsessed with achieving the merits necessary for promotion.
While she acknowledges Leil’s skills as captain,her own pride seems to fuel a one-sided rivalry.
translation:
The Auditor

A serious auditor dispatched by the ship’s sponsor.
She served as Leil’s second-in-command during her military service, and after Leil left the military, she was expected to be promoted but was not.

While she acknowledges Leil’s skills as captain,her own pride seems to fuel a one-sided rivalry.
